declaration: Amendment recorded before exploratory data collection and dry_run_3.
reason: Exploratory design with one scene per viewing direction, YUY2 capture, locally retained raw data, live clipping/reference-exposure preview and descriptive room-level reporting.
numbering_note: Amendment numbering follows the recorded sequence. No Amendment 2 record was found; its content or existence is not assumed. This amendment replaces the earlier Z/N tabletop design.

framework.supersedes: The primary hypothesis and confirmatory interpretations in the earlier plan do not apply to this exploratory check. Private original plans remain unchanged.
framework.reporting_decision: Reporting is descriptive; no confirmatory claim.
framework.summary: Equal-weight scene means; descriptive 2000 scene bootstrap percentile intervals with original seed 20261018. No significance verdict or zero-crossing test. Original selectors, metrics, ties, top-1 and LPIPS fuzzy-minus-fixed definition unchanged.

scene_design.unit: One viewing direction = one scene. Fixed camera support, rotate only between scenes; one or two indoor rooms. Camera, objects and illumination fixed from first through last reference.

labels.room_label: Required nonempty free text for each real scene; editable before next scene.
labels.direction_label: Required nonempty free text for each real scene; unique (room_label,direction_label) among accepted scenes, preventing accidental duplicate direction labels.

scene_design.rooms: Report overall scene means and per-room descriptive summaries if more than one distinct room label. Bootstrap resamples scenes within each reported room; >=2 room scenes required for interval, otherwise null with reason. Room labels are descriptive strata, not independent experimental replicates.

camera.setting_order: width,height,FPS then FOURCC=YUY2 last; the webcam control settings remain unchanged
camera.validation: Read back backend, dimensions, FOURCC after opening, before each scene, after each exposure change and for every saved image, and at completion. Abort/reject on mismatch; no MJPG fallback. YUY2 is the uncompressed transport, OpenCV returns BGR8 and local files remain lossless PNG.
camera.MJPG_scope: Only the separate live timing experiments, not this exploratory capture.

live_fields: candidate E0 or no valid candidate
preview.keys: 1/2/3 preview -3/-2/-1, E rescans candidates, L edits labels, Space acquires exactly one complete scene after a fresh E0 scan, Q/Esc exits. Preview pixels are neither saved nor used in analysis.
preview.ready_rule: Current five-frame average meets E0 luminance/clipping and E0-4 >=-7. Final capture always independently rechecks canonical candidate order and full unchanged QC.
preview.interaction: Viewing direction and indirect lighting may be adjusted during preview only. No camera or scene movement during automatic capture.

privacy.candidate_images: data/candidate_cache/<analysis_run>/; float32 arrays retained locally for unchanged scientific metrics and verification
privacy.derived_root: derived/<analysis_run>/; tables only: candidate features/scores/LPIPS/PSNR/SSIM, selections, scene means, room summaries, QC ledger. No image pixels or local absolute image paths in export tables.
privacy.gitignore: Ignore data/, image formats, image arrays/candidate caches, old image-bearing smoke outputs, and bundles. .gitignore is not a packaging guarantee.
privacy.package_policy: export_derived.py whitelists known table/summary filenames in a chosen derived run and refuses image/array files, symlinks and non-derived sources. Raw images are excluded from distribution.
privacy.legacy: Existing raw records and candidate caches remain local and unchanged, covered by ignore rules.

E0.no_valid_E0: Reject attempt; adjust diffuse illumination or scene outside capture, keep camera fixed, then retry. Never relax threshold or accept plateau.

QC.threshold_rule: max(30,min(40,floor(B two-16-frame-reference PSNR -6))); 40 dB here leaves >=7 dB margin from B static noise observation
QC.clipping_definition: any RGB channel at 255 in any averaged reference pixel; fraction; per-frame clipping also logged
QC.settings: fixed controls and requested exposure readback must match; manual AF uses DSHOW flag=2; DSHOW AUTO_EXPOSURE -1 readback is backend limitation, not proof
QC.failed_scene: exclude entire scene from every analysis and publishable dataset; keep reason and private rejected record; never silently drop individual frames
QC.scene: static indoor objects only; tripod/stable stand; illumination and camera untouched from first to final reference
QC.stop_luminance: At native resolution, each raw frame gray8 = cv2.cvtColor(BGR uint8,COLOR_BGR2GRAY), mean(gray8)/255. Reference baseline is mean of 16 beginning raw-frame luminances; stop is mean of its five raw-frame luminances.
QC.boundary: <= 0.90 * previous and >= 0.084 inclusive, no tolerance adjustment
QC.failure: Entire scene excluded from analysis and publishable data; reasons retained; dry_run remains excluded regardless of QC.

selection.adaptive: only nine grid gammas; default 2/3 scored separately
selection.tie: lexsort(gamma, round(abs(gamma-2/3),12), round(abs(gamma-prev),12)); prev resets to 2/3 per scene/selector; previous input in stop-major order
selection.invalid: ignore nonfinite; if every candidate invalid use full grid then same tie rule; primary LPIPS nonfinite aborts analysis
selection.top1: exact tied maxima receive fractional hit against minimum LPIPS; primary controller tie rule remains the stated 1e-9 plateau rule; pairwise predicted ties half credit as closed_loop common.within_group

scoring.input: cv2 RGB, INTER_LINEAR resize 256x256 on uint8 then float32 /255; gamma_image with exact 1.0/(1/g)
scoring.reference: average 16 raw uint8 frames in native resolution; store exact uint16 sum with scale 16*255; convert float32 average then INTER_LINEAR 256x256 and /255
scoring.reference_for_scoring: mean of beginning/end 16-frame references after QC
scoring.metrics: LPIPS-Alex via pyiqa lpips; same evaluation.metrics PSNR/SSIM
scoring.device: CUDA if available, CPU otherwise; no model training

dry_run_3.name: dry_run_3
dry_run_3.scope: Verify actual YUY2 readback, preview calculations, canonical E0 search and unchanged QC. If E0 fails, preserve rejection and do not force full scene or retry for a pass. Exercise remaining QC boundaries with synthetic engineering fixtures, explicitly not camera evidence. No LPIPS quality analysis or bootstrap from dry-run.
dry_run_3.timing: No performance timing. Other evaluation workloads remain uninterrupted; the dry run waits if the resource check fails.
